# Solura Cosmetics

> Premium innovative herbal skincare and haircare crafted in India. Guest-friendly checkout — track orders by phone number, no account required.

Solura Cosmetics offers small-batch, GMP / ISO / Cruelty Free / Non GMO compliant beauty products formulated with natural ingredients. Exclusive offer: save 10%–30% today, with free shipping on prepaid orders.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Brand overview and featured products.
- [Shop](/shop): Full catalog of skincare and haircare products.
- [Blog](/blog): Skincare and haircare guides, ingredient deep-dives, and natural beauty tips.
- [About](/about): Mission, values, and frequently asked questions.
- [Founder Story](/founder-story): How Solura grew from a student startup pitch to a national brand.

## Optional

- [My Orders](/my-orders): Order tracking by phone number for guest customers.
